title: TTS normalizer rules document (all locales)
description: Shared schema for rules/en.json, rules/zh.json, rules/ar.json, rules/bn.json, rules/ru.json, and future rules/<locale>.json. Not loaded at runtime. Locale-specific rules (e.g. pinyin) appear only in the JSON files that need them; this schema does not require every locale to include every field.

locale.description: Passed to the engine as localeTag_ (e.g. en, zh).

digit_names.description: Ten entries: spoken names for digits 0–9.

month_names.description: Optional: up to 12 locale-specific month names used by date formatting ops.

month_names_en.description: Legacy alias for month_names (kept for backward compatibility).

month_names_ar.description: Optional: up to 12 strings for Arabic Gregorian month names (used with `date_iso_en` when locale is ar).

month_names_bn.description: Optional: up to 12 strings for Bengali Gregorian month names (used with `date_iso_en` when locale is bn).

month_names_ru.description: Optional: up to 12 strings for Russian month names (used with `date_iso_en` when locale is ru).

currency_map.description: Symbol or code → spoken suffix after spellout amount.

unit_composite.description: Composite unit token → spoken suffix after spellout number.

unit_single.description: Single unit token → spoken suffix after spellout number.

pattern_defs.description: Phase B: reusable ICU regex fragments. Values may reference each other via {{NAME}}; rule.pattern may use {{NAME}}; engine expands at loadRules() time.

rules.description: Pipeline order. Each item is replace-only, exec, or a dedicated C++ action.

execStep.description: Primitive op and op-specific fields; extend ops in tts_ops.md when adding branches in applyExecStep.

rule.description: Exactly one of: replace-only (no action), exec, or dedicated action.

action.description: When adding a new dedicated action in applyAction, append it here.

params.description: Ignored for these actions today; allowed for forward compatibility.
